scope: Owned disposable local Vere 4.6 ship, published-alpha source installed before in-place candidate upgrade
boundary: The source alpha used a fixed account ID. The candidate intentionally revokes its old local session and Connect grant during migration; the user must approve a new SSO login. Vault contents and item identity were preserved. This is not a proof that the old grant remains valid or that every official client upgrades without sign-in.
